summary: Add -o ServerAliveInterval=N to ssh_args, or set it in your SSH config, so Ansible notices dead targets quickly instead of waiting for TCP timeout; with ServerAliveCountMax=3 the wait is tripled.
questions: Ansible hangs for a long time when a host dies, how do I detect it faster?
Where do I set ServerAliveInterval for Ansible?

answer_card.title: Detect dead targets faster
answer_card.answer_md:
Add a keepalive to SSH args:

```ini
[ssh_connection]
ssh_args = -C -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPersist=60s -o ServerAliveInterval=15
```

The default `ServerAliveCountMax=3` means the session ends after about 3 × the interval without replies.
